review.notes: All 21 source/Greek pairs read in full. All item-name placeholders stay uninflected in quotes; explicit neuter προϊόν agrees with empty/fresh article branch, all adjective alternatives, and subsequent pronouns. SeedShop.cs.9701 deliberately includes one trailing space so the native empty and fresh branches both form correct text; both ShopLocation and FishShop call sites were checked. Aroma uses neuter άρωμα. Chef adjectives refer to Pierre and are masculine regardless of speaker sex. Pierre taking credit, rude reactions, compost jokes, hoisin sauce, names and every control marker retained.
